sentences.text: The KFS shown in the evidence lists only a one-time processing fee of ₹400, while the home loan agreement also lists a documentation fee of ₹500 payable at execution.
The earlier KFS rule said fees not mentioned in the KFS cannot be charged at any stage during the loan term without explicit consent, but that rule is now superseded.
The current applicable rule says fees not in the KFS are permitted only as per the stated conditions, but those stated conditions are not provided in the evidence here.
On the evidence provided, I cannot confirm that the ₹500 documentation fee may be charged solely because it appears in the home loan agreement when it is not listed in the KFS.

missing.slot: stated conditions for fees not in the KFS under the current UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025
missing.searched: Looked for the full text of the applicable conditions referenced by the rule finding; only the summary finding was provided.
